subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + conditional Net-90 pilot for Veridian Labs
messages:
From: Lena Martin <lena.martin@veridianlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quarterly invoicing + payment terms request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the run-through this morning — the product looked promising. Our finance team asked whether Veridian could move to quarterly invoicing instead of monthly for the first year of the contract, and whether we could pilot a Net-90 payment window tied to an early-adopter discount.

High level:
- Contract value: $420k ARR (annualized)
- Preferred billing: Quarterly invoicing, consolidated invoice per quarter
- Pilot payment term: Net-90 for Q1 and Q2 invoices only, subject to standard credit checks
- Ask: Can Redwood accommodate the quarterly cadence and conditional Net-90? If so, are there any commercial adjustments (discount, fee) required?

We can provide PO templates and a billing contact if that helps. Attaching a short SOW draft we reviewed.

Best,
Lena Martin
Head of Procurement, Veridian Labs
Attachment: SOW_Veridian_v2.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Lena Martin <lena.martin@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quarterly invoicing + payment terms request

Hi Lena — thanks for the clarity and the SOW. I looped in our deal desk to map commercial implications. Short answer: quarterly invoicing is operationally fine; Net-90 as a pilot is an exception and will need executive signoff and a limited contract clause (pilot duration + credit hold).

For transparency, two asks from our side before I escalate:
1) Can you confirm billing contact and PO cadence (will Veridian issue a single PO per quarter or per invoice)?
2) Would you be willing to accept a 1.75% early-adopter discount in exchange for the Net-90 pilot and consolidated invoicing? (This helps offset working capital impact.)

If you prefer I can submit for approval today and share back the conditional language.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Veridian — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot — Exec approval request

Forwarding the customer request and Grace's note.

Summary for approval:
- Account: Veridian Labs (VD-2027-0421)
- ARR: $420k (12 months)
- Request: Switch to quarterly invoicing; pilot Net-90 for first two quarters only
- Commercial tradeoff proposed by AE: 1.75% one-time discount applied to first-year invoices to offset cash timing
- Operational requirements: PO per quarter, billing contact Daniel Ortiz (d.ortiz@veridianlabs.com), signed SOW and pilot clause (clause to include rollback to monthly billing if invoice is overdue past 120 days)
- Risk note: Moderate working capital hit if we accept Net-90; mitigations: discount, pilot cap (2 quarters), and credit hold trigger at 120 days

Recommendation: Approve pilot with the commercial offset (1.75%) and legal to include the rollback + credit hold terms. Need exec OK to proceed.

Attachments: Pricing_Table_Veridian.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Deal Desk Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Veridian — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot — Exec approval request

Aditya / Grace — I reviewed the numbers and the risk mitigations. Approve the Net-90 pilot for Q1 and Q2 with the following conditions:

1) Discount: 1.75% applied to invoices for the pilot period only; no permanent list price change.
2) Pilot cap: maximum exposure capped at $210k (i.e., no more than 50% of annual committed amount across pilot invoices).
3) Credit protections: automated credit hold if any invoice exceeds 120 days; finance reserves right to demand prepayment for subsequent quarters if aging occurs.
4) Legal language: rollback clause to monthly billing if pilot triggers more than one missed payment event.

If legal signs off on the clause language, proceed to confirm with the customer and update the SOW. Please ensure finance logs the payment plan in our collections tracker and marks the account for enhanced monitoring for the pilot duration.

Jonas
VP, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Lena Martin <lena.martin@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quarterly invoicing + payment terms request — Approved pilot terms

Hi Lena — good news: Redwood can run a limited Net-90 pilot for Veridian under the conditions below (approved by our finance leadership). Please find the summary and next steps.

Approved terms (pilot):
- Billing cadence: Quarterly invoicing (one consolidated invoice per quarter)
- Pilot payment window: Net-90 for Q1 and Q2 only
- Discount: 1.75% applied to pilot-period invoices only
- Pilot cap: Maximum exposure $210,000 across the pilot (first two quarters)
- Credit protections: If any invoice ages past 120 days, finance may place the account on a credit hold and require prepayment for future invoices; repeated missed payments may roll the account back to monthly billing

Next steps:
1) Daniel — confirm PO cadence (one PO per quarter) and return signed SOW (SOW_Veridian_v2.pdf)
2) Legal will add the pilot/rollback clause and send a clean SOW for signature (I cc'd Aditya and Jonas so they can coordinate finance/legal hooks).
3) We'll update the HubSpot deal and DocuSign template once legal confirms language.

Thanks all — I will follow up once legal returns the updated SOW.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
